questions.stem: A 60-year-old man, with a background of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, long-term alcohol abuse, and homelessness, is hospitalized due to acute pneumonia. During a ward examination, you observe a brownish-red discoloration on his face, neck, forearms, and lower legs, accompanied by skin scaling and cracks. He reports difficulties with eating and drinking, ongoing vomiting, diarrhea, and appears somewhat disoriented. Which vitamin deficiency might be responsible for these symptoms?
